reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit. Section 6 is completely triaged: ten numbered items provisionally match, while the n=2 statements in Lemma 6.8(iv) and Theorem 6.2 are directly refuted by an independently audited, nonvacuous actual 2-ADC counterexample. The same omitted class refutes the binary Theorem 1.9(ii) and changes Theorem 1.10 from +1 to +2; an exact corrected six-family catalogue is proved. Every dyadic branch of Theorem 1.10 has an exact complete and irredundant integral-isometry catalogue, with the printed binary count kept separate from its correction. For the non-dyadic branch, the finite-catalogue deduction remains conditional on explicit arithmetic classification laws, but publisher Table 4.7 itself is now concretely certified at the symbolic row, rank, Jordan-rank, exact unary/binary-domain, and rank-four case-split levels. The full non-dyadic Lemma 4.7(ii), Lemma 4.14, and Propositions 4.15--4.16 deductions are proved from explicit catalogue, realization, maximal-lattice existence, maximal-overlattice, same-rank transfer, representation transport, and deletion-witness laws; Proposition 4.15 is no longer itself a catalogue-law field, while concrete local-lattice instances remain pending. The finite logical layers of Corollary 1.8 and Theorem 1.11 are proved. All 48 publisher Table 1 matrices, their printed discriminants, exact rational positive definiteness, and the literal 21-row last-column selection are concrete, but the Hanke-Kirschmer-Oh catalogue identifications and actual local checks remain explicit inputs. Lemma 2.2 is fully formalized for every number field and finite-place completion. O'Meara 63:9 is now proved internally from the principal-unit filtration, so the unary, Corollary 7.21, corrected binary, and all dyadic Theorem 1.10 numerical formulas have no caller-supplied counting premise. Theorem 7.1 is proved, but its printed proof omits the second boundary class. Section 7 has 20/21 fully formalized numbered items; Lemma 7.13 has a printed quantifier mismatch. Every numbered deduction in Sections 5 and 8, plus Theorems 1.5 and 1.7, is proved from explicit law packages, but their concrete non-dyadic and number-field instances remain pending. Reports 26-65 give the scope. The exact clean Review Kit for 7d7a4d5 contains 2,060 payload hashes and passes a fresh 5,560-job build, the canonical He ADC audit, both concrete Q_2 boundary audits, and the 60,594-declaration enforcing gate. The newer Table 1 and Table 4.7 certificates have exact local build evidence; exact clean-kit receipts are being advanced separately. GitHub-hosted exact-tag CI and artifact upload, remaining arithmetic and external-catalogue instances, release promotion, and human sign-off remain separate gates.
